Messages.Author: Reyda
Messages.Body:
A bunch of conceptual question :
-can you mask the bleeding action resulting from The portrait with another
toreador ?
-with a vampire from another clan ?

-can you mask an action being modified by The Grandest Trick ?
-can you play Malleable Visage when a vampire is blocked during a grandest
trick action ?

thank you
(and, yeah, i'm trying to find a use for those oh-so-useful cards :) )

Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
On Sun, 21 Sep 2003 16:06:50 +0200, "Reyda" <true_...@hotmail.com>
wrote:

>A bunch of conceptual question :
>-can you mask the bleeding action resulting from The portrait with another
>toreador ?

No.
None of the other vampires took the Portrait action.

>-with a vampire from another clan ?

No.

>-can you mask an action being modified by The Grandest Trick ?

Yes.
Mask allows a vampire to take over an action begun by an ally.

See also the RTR of 05-01-2002.

http://groups.google.com/groups?selm=3CD0043D.410398C1%40white-wolf.com

THE GRANDEST TRICK makes vampires unable to block the minion who
played it, not the action in general (so if it is Masked, vampires can
attempt to block the new acting vampire).

>-can you play Malleable Visage when a vampire is blocked during a grandest
>trick action ?

Yes.

The Grandest Trick makes the acting vampire an ally for all effects
until the action ends. Malleable Visage is playable at inferior when
an ally is blocked.

>thank you
>(and, yeah, i'm trying to find a use for those oh-so-useful cards :) )

Good luck.

Carpe noctem.

This seems to directly contradict the latest rtr:
"Mask of a Thousand Faces (REVERSAL): All effects that had been
applied to the action or the acting minion carry over as if they had
been applied with the Masker as the acting minion."

Surely the +bleed and stealth apply to the Toreador, and thus _should_
carry over through a mask?

Which then leads us to:

"The standing rule that "Mask cannot be used to mask an action if the
Masking vampire is not capable of taking that action, nor if any
action modifiers have been played on this action that could not have
been played if the Masking vampire were the acting minion. (Not
counting blood that has already been spent.)" still applies, and it
applies to other effects as well. So if Backways is tapped to give the
acting Gangrel a stealth, then non-Gangrel cannot mask the action. If
Redirection is used at inferior by a 7 capacity vampire, then vampires
with capacity of 7 or more cannot mask the action (since they are not
younger than the reacting vampire). And so on."

As any potential maskers were not eligable for the +bleed/stealth, due
to none of them having just played The Portrait, surely they cannot
mask? Just like tapping a backways in an action means it can't be
maked to non-gangrel, the Portrait, being the previous action, will
only give it's +'s to the person who played it. It couldn't have been
applied to the person currently trying to mask.

> "Mask of a Thousand Faces (REVERSAL): All effects that had been
> applied to the action or the acting minion carry over as if they had
> been applied with the Masker as the acting minion."

It is not. This is the same as Ozmo bleeding and then Normal masking.

Ozmo's bleed bonus doesn't carry over.

The bleed bonus from Portrait is not one that was applied just during
the bleed action. It was given to that Portraiting minion prior to
the bleed action (that is, during the Portrait action).

> Surely the +bleed and stealth apply to the Toreador, and thus _should_
> carry over through a mask?

They apply to the vampire, extant from prior to the action, like Ozmo's
bonus, and thus don't carry.
